voice.set.asks: Voice mode never answers an ask. When there is something to approve, it stops and waits for you to decide with the card.
voice.set.checking: Checking what this Mac can do
voice.set.kept: Nothing is recorded. No audio is written to a file, and neither the audio nor the words heard go to a log.
voice.set.langHint: The microphone and voice mode listen for this language.
voice.set.noVoice: This Mac has no voice for {lang} yet; the Mac's default reads it.
voice.set.none: {lang}: this Mac cannot turn it into text.
voice.set.notMac: Voice works in the Mac app only.
voice.set.onDevice: {lang}: recognized on this Mac. Nothing is sent.
voice.set.read: Answers are read aloud by this Mac's own voices, on this Mac.
voice.set.thaiLater: Thai on this Mac alone is not here yet: this Mac says it cannot recognize Thai by itself. If it can later, Manut AI uses it on the Mac by itself, with nothing sent.
voice.set.voiceHint: Voice mode reads answers aloud with this voice, on this Mac.
voice.set.whereHint: This Mac only: nothing is sent anywhere. Apple when needed: a language this Mac cannot recognize by itself is sent to Apple's servers while you speak.
watch.form.hint: This sends the sentence to {bot}'s chat. {bot} confirms with you before it sets anything up.
watch.form.title: New channel watch
watch.msg: Watch {platform} {channel} and tell me first when a post is about: {what}. Check {every}.
watch.notUsefulMsg: The watch "{name}" flagged this, but it was not useful: "{alert}". Flag less like it from now on.
watch.notUsefulTip: Tell the bot this alert was not worth it
watch.note: You can also change it by telling {bot} in chat, e.g. "Check {name} every 15 minutes" or "Pause {name}".
watch.why.channel: The bot isn't in {channel}, or the channel is gone or private. Invite the bot there.
watch.why.config: The watch's settings file is missing or broken. Ask the bot to set the watch up again.
watch.why.failed: The last check failed. Ask the bot what went wrong.
watch.why.noToken: No {platform} bot token is set for this bot.
watch.why.scope: The bot token lacks a permission it needs to read history (Slack: channels:history).
watch.why.token: The {platform} bot token was rejected. Set a new one in the bot's .env.
wf.allow.hint: It will run only these steps, in this project. If its file changes, it waits until you look at it again.
wf.allowed: You allowed these steps to run. If its file changes, it waits until you look at it again.
wf.careful: Nobody may be watching a workflow's lane, so it starts at the most careful setting: Kit asks before every change in it, whatever the project's dial says, and the agent runs in its Ask mode. Reading files and running the tests do not ask.
wf.file.agent: Its agent: an agent's id, such as claude or codex.
wf.file.day: Its day of the month: 1 to 28, or "last".
wf.file.duplicate: Another workflow has the same name: {detail}.
wf.file.field: It has a field this app does not know: {detail}.
wf.file.file_name: Its file name: use letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores, ending in .json.
wf.file.json: It is not valid JSON. Check the commas, quotes and brackets.
wf.file.link: It is a link, so it is not read.
wf.file.name: Its name: 1 to 80 characters.
wf.file.project: Its project: a full folder path, such as /Users/you/code/shop.
wf.file.schedule: Its schedule: every day, chosen days or a day of the month, each at a time.
wf.file.shape: It must hold one workflow, in curly brackets.
wf.file.step: Step {detail} is empty or longer than 4,000 characters.
wf.file.steps: Its steps: a list of 1 to 20 messages.
wf.file.unseen: It has characters that do not show on screen, such as zero-width or text-direction marks, so it is not read.
wf.file.version: Its version is not one this app reads.
wf.file.zone: Its time zone is not one this computer knows. Use a name such as Asia/Bangkok.
wf.folder.hint: One JSON file for each workflow. The app reads this folder and never changes a file in it.
wf.folder.link: The workflows folder is a link, so it is not read. Make it a real folder.
wf.folder.missing: There is no workflows folder yet. Show folder makes it.
wf.folder.title: Workflows folder
wf.folder.unreadable: The workflows folder could not be read.
wf.kept.bad: Type a whole number from 0 to 500.
wf.kept.hint: How many skipped runs each workflow keeps in its history. 0 keeps none.
wf.kept.title: Skipped runs kept
wf.lane.careful: This lane runs the workflow "{name}", so Kit asks before every change in it, whatever the project's dial says.
wf.lane.note: This lane runs the workflow "{name}". Nobody may be watching it, so Kit asks before every change, whatever the project's dial says.
wf.live.waiting: Waiting for you at step {step} of {steps}: Kit asks on its card.
wf.manual: Runs when you press Run now
wf.none: No workflows yet. Put a workflow's file in the workflows folder.
wf.off: Turn Workflows on to run one.
wf.on.hint: Runs coding work by itself from the workflow files in this app's workflows folder. Each run is a lane on your own agent and your own plan, and its asks wait for you. Only while this app is open and the Mac is awake. While off, nothing in the folder runs.
wf.on.title: Workflows
wf.refused.unreadable: Its file cannot be read now.
wf.stand.changed: This workflow's file changed. Look at it again.
wf.stand.not_allowed: Not allowed to run yet. Read its steps under Steps and project, then allow it.
wf.when.last: On the last day of each month at {at}
wf.when.monthly: On day {day} of each month at {at}
wf.why.agent: Its agent is not installed, is turned off in Settings › Providers, or cannot chat here.
wf.why.app_closed: The app closed while it ran.
wf.why.app_folder: Its project is inside this app's own folder or a lane's folder. Name one of your repositories' own folders.
wf.why.asleep: The Mac was asleep, or the app could not check the clock.
wf.why.busy: Its last run was still going.
wf.why.changed: This workflow's file changed. Look at it again.
wf.why.config: Did not run: this project's own git settings name a program for git to run, or another address to fetch from. The app does not run those by itself while nobody is there; press Run now if you trust them.
wf.why.link: Its project's path goes through a link, or is not written as the folder's real path. Write the folder's real path.
wf.why.missing: Its project folder is not there, or is not a folder.
wf.why.moved: Its project folder is not the one you allowed. Look at it again.
wf.why.no_git: git is not installed, so its lane cannot be made.
wf.why.no_lane: A lane of its own could not be made in its project, so nothing ran.
wf.why.not_allowed: It was not allowed to run yet.
wf.why.not_repo: Its project is not the top folder of a git repository.
wf.why.person: You stopped it after a step.
wf.why.send: The next step could not be sent.
wf.why.too_broad: Its project is the home folder, the top of a disk, or a folder that holds the home folder or this app's folder. Name one repository's own folder.
wf.why.unchecked: Its project folder could not be checked.
win.closeHint: Manut AI stays in the menu bar and your terminals and agents keep working. Quit from its icon.
win.closeHintOther: Manut AI stays in the notification area and your terminals and agents keep working. Quit from its icon.
worktrees.deleted.hint: Only when nothing in it is changed or new and every commit on its branch is on a remote. Otherwise the folder is kept and listed under the lanes. The branch always stays.
worktrees.deleted.title: Remove the folder when its chat is deleted
worktrees.merged.hint: Reads your pull requests through gh or glab when a project opens, at most once an hour. Only when the commits are in the default branch, nothing in the folder is changed or new and no chat still works in it. Without gh or glab signed in, it says it cannot tell and does nothing.
worktrees.merged.title: Remove the folder when its pull request has merged
worktrees.prefix.form: Use lower case letters, numbers and hyphens only, in one or two words that each end with a slash.
worktrees.prefix.hint: Every lane's branch starts with this, so you can tell Kit's branches apart. One or two lower case words, each followed by a slash, such as kit/ or team/ana/.
worktrees.prefix.slash: End the prefix with a slash, such as kit/.
worktrees.prefix.title: Branch prefix
worktrees.remote.hint: A new lane starts from the latest commit of its base branch on the remote. Kit fetches that one branch first, waits at most 10 seconds and never asks for a password. If it cannot, or your own branch has commits the remote lacks, the lane starts from your own branch and says so.
worktrees.remote.title: Start from the remote
worktrees.root.bad_root: That is not a folder Kit can use. Choose a full folder path.
worktrees.root.chat: The folder chosen for lanes cannot be used now, so no lane was made and Kit works in this project's own folder. Change it in Settings, Worktrees.
worktrees.root.root_in_checkout: That folder is inside a project's own files, so a lane's folder would sit among them. Choose a folder outside every project.
worktrees.root.root_too_broad: That folder is too broad: it is your home folder, the disk's top, or Manut AI's own data. Choose another.
worktrees.root.root_unwritable: Kit cannot write in that folder. Choose one you can save files in.
worktrees.where.hint: Each lane works in a folder of its own. Choose where those folders go. Lanes already made stay where they are.
worktrees.where.title: Where lanes are made
